review.notes: Drafted for #5. A present-day place: time.start is the date the cemetery was established, not a battle date. Wikipedia's History paragraph is internally inconsistent: it says a temporary cemetery was established on 6 June 1944 and then 'After the war, on June 8, 1944, the present-day cemetery was established'; Wikidata P571 also gives 8 June 1944. 8 June is used for time.start, and the 6 June temporary cemetery is recorded as a separate fact. Confirm both against ABMC (abmc.gov is not reachable from this session). Gravesite counts disagree slightly (Wikipedia 9,389, Wikidata 9,387), so they are recorded as a disputed range. Coordinate is Wikidata P625 (4 decimals), a single point for a ~70 ha site, so accuracy is representative. OSM relation id comes from Wikidata P402 and was not checked against OSM directly (overpass-api.de connections failed).

summary.text: American war cemetery and memorial on the bluff above Omaha Beach at Colleville-sur-Mer. Most of those buried there died in the Normandy landings and the fighting that followed. It is run by the American Battle Monuments Commission.
